🌟 Floating Buddies – Animated Companions That Live on Your Screen 🌟

Floating Buddies turns your Android into a playful canvas packed with animated overlay pets, physics-driven reactions, and premium customization options. This SEO-friendly summary keeps things punchy while spotlighting the standout features that users search for most.

 ✨ Highlights at a Glance

- 🧸 Overlay companions stay visible while you multitask, adding charm to every screen.
- 🏃 Status bar runners sprint, leap, and wave without interrupting your notifications.
- 🪂 Hanging buddies sway with gravity-aware motion for a dynamic status bar.
- 🎲 Random physics combos shuffle duos and premium-only mega squads.
- 🎯 Curated launch decks trigger themed crews with one tap.
- 🧠 Smart cues gently remind you about focus sessions or hydration.
- 🌈 Customization controls adjust scale, position, speed, and opacity in seconds.
- ⭐ Favorites Lounge keeps your most-loved characters ready to relaunch.
- 🎨 Own Buddies creator (premium) turns your photos into custom mascots.

 🧩 Premium Upgrade Perks

-  Lift the two-buddy limit for full-screen squads.
- 🧑‍🎨 Unlock Own Buddies Studio with guided cutouts and animation presets.
- 🧩 Enable trio-plus random combos for larger physics shows.
- 🏆 Access exclusive premium characters and choreography.
- 🧽 Remove rewarded ads once you upgrade.

 🔐 Privacy & Monetization

- 🔒 No personal data collection; everything stays on-device.
-  Offline-friendly playback for previously unlocked buddies.
-  Optional rewarded ads (two per unlock) offer free premium characters.
-  One-time premium purchase—no loot boxes or subscriptions.
-  Google Play Billing ensures secure transactions.

 🚀 Getting Started

1. 📥 Install and grant overlay permission.
2. 🔔 Allow notifications for helpful status reminders.
3. 🪄 Explore Inspire tab to sample animated crews.
4. ⭐ Favorite characters and build your launch deck.
5. 🎲 Test random physics combos; upgrade for trio-plus chaos.
6. 🧑‍🎨 Go premium to craft personalized Own Buddies companions.

 📱 Perfect For

- 🗓️ Productivity lovers who want motivational mascots.
- 🧘 Mindfulness fans using calming physics as break cues.
- � Streamers seeking interactive overlays for followers.
- 📸 Families converting pet photos into on-screen pals.
- 🛍️ Brands showcasing mascots during events and demos.
